name: Cross Romance: Koi to Mahjong to Hanafuda to
summary: Cross Romance: Koi to Mahjong to Hanafuda to is a great mix of adventure, love, and a mahjong game. The player controls a high school student that seems to be like a mahjong hero of his town and he will meet different girls during the game that will try to defeat him. The goal of the game is to win the six days tournament that takes places in the town.
